CasBrief.ground_scheme_summary: Task Force Bastion attacks north from PL BRASS to PL ZINC; friendlies report the last phase line crossed.

hazards.description: Power lines across the wadi south of the target.

CasBrief.target_description: ISIS command post and vehicle park.

coordination_instructions: Enter only from Marshal after Banshee reports the box open.
ControlMeasure.description: Kill Box (KB) over the Cobalt compound west of the Euphrates, north of the transit and rescue areas.
ControlMeasure.name: Cobalt kill box
ControlMeasure.notes: Banshee opens the box only after Sweeper reports the area clear of civilian traffic.
ControlMeasure.purpose: Air-to-surface attacks on the Cobalt compound and vehicle park.
restrictions: Firing status follows the assignment intervals below; no attacks on the river crossings.

Geometry_description.text: Euphrates west bank from the Deir ez-Zor bridge to the Al Busayrah ferry

Hazard.description: Bullseye for air-to-air calls in OIR.

bastion-bullseye.description: Bullseye for air-to-air calls in OIR.
bastion-bullseye.name: Bastion bullseye

coordination_instructions: Coordinate with Warhawk and Darkstar before flying or firing through 11000 feet MSL inside the Task Force Bastion area.
No coordinating altitude applies beyond the FSCL or inside an open kill box.
bastion-ca.description: Coordinating altitude over Task Force Bastion, from the boundary to the RFL and from PL BRASS to the FSCL; Warhawk controls the assigned airspace below it, and Darkstar the airspace above it.
bastion-ca.name: OIR coordinating altitude

coordination_instructions: Enter only from Marshal after Banshee reports the box open.
cobalt-box.description: Kill Box (KB) over the Cobalt compound west of the Euphrates, north of the transit and rescue areas.
cobalt-box.name: Cobalt kill box
cobalt-box.notes: Banshee opens the box only after Sweeper reports the area clear of civilian traffic.
cobalt-box.purpose: Air-to-surface attacks on the Cobalt compound and vehicle park.
restrictions: Firing status follows the assignment intervals below; no attacks on the river crossings.

dz-tin.description: Drop zone for the airborne platoon on the south flank of Task Force Bastion, south of PL BRASS.
dz-tin.name: DZ Tin
dz-tin.purpose: Drop zone for the airborne platoon on the south flank of Task Force Bastion, south of PL BRASS.

coordination_instructions: Report Falcon on station and off station to Darkstar on 251.000 MHz AM.
falcon.description: Combat air patrol racetrack north of the support orbits, facing the northern threat axis.
falcon.name: Falcon patrol
falcon.purpose: Falcon protects the strike package and the high-value orbits from the north.
restrictions: Remain between FL220 and FL260; do not cross south of Shell without Darkstar approval.

gainful-misarc.description: Expected engagement sector of the SA-6 battery toward the Anvil ingress from the south-west.
gainful-misarc.name: Gainful missile arc
restrictions: Attack only while the Cobalt kill box is open.

ghi.name: Muwaffaq Salti VORTAC
ghi.source: DCS World Syria map: AirfieldsTaxiways layer, radio.lua and beacons.lua

isis-held.description: Land that ISIS holds north of the FLOT, drawn in a GIS tool: a GeoJSON multipolygon (longitude first).
isis-held.name: ISIS-held Euphrates valley
isis-held.notes: The boundary follows the FLOT; it moves when the FLOT moves.

coordination_instructions: Banshee hands inbound flights to Darkstar at Juniper.
juniper.description: Ingress gate west of At Tanf where traffic from Muwaffaq Salti enters the operating area under Darkstar control.
instructions: Report Juniper with altitude and playtime; Darkstar assigns the corridor slot.
juniper.name: Juniper
juniper.notes: Expect a Darkstar picture call at Juniper; squawk the ATO Mode 3 code before the gate.
juniper.position_description: Southwestern ingress gate; beginning of the Juniper-to-Marshal transit corridor.
restrictions: Do not pass Juniper northbound without a Darkstar check-in.

oir-aor.description: Area of responsibility of the CJTF-OIR air component in this order, from eastern Jordan to the Euphrates valley; the airspace control area follows it.
oir-aor.name: OIR area of responsibility

coordination_instructions: No fires or their effects across the line without coordination with the affected task force.
pewter-rfl.description: Restrictive fire line between Task Force Bastion attacking north and Task Force Pewter converging from the east; set by the partner land force, the common commander.
pewter-rfl.name: Bastion and Pewter RFL

coordination_instructions: Task Force Bastion crosses PL BRASS at 1330Z after the Cobalt kill box opens.
pl-brass.description: Phase line BRASS, designated as the line of departure of Task Force Bastion; it follows the FLOT at the start of the period.
pl-brass.name: PL BRASS

quarry-nfa.description: No-fire area that protects a civilian water pumping station between the FLOT and the FSCL.
quarry-nfa.name: Quarry Springs NFA
restrictions: No fires or effects into the area unless the establishing headquarters approves each mission.

coordination_instructions: Contact Banshee on 305.000 MHz AM before approaching the boundary.
rescue-reservation.description: Restricted Operating Zone (ROZ) that protects the search for the isolated aircrew of Hawg 2, east of the transit route.
rescue-reservation.name: Rescue reservation
rescue-reservation.notes: Survivor last reported on the eastern edge; Pedro has on-scene command.
rescue-reservation.purpose: Reserve the search area for the rescue package.
restrictions: Other aircraft remain outside until Banshee releases the reservation.

rp-nickel.description: Release point of the air assault serials.
rp-nickel.name: RP Nickel

coordination_instructions: Helicopters inbound to Sage enter on the Sage FARP approach after the air defence controller confirms weapons hold.
sage-shoradez.description: Short-range air defence engagement zone over the Sage FARP, where an Avenger platoon has engagement responsibility.
sage-shoradez.name: Sage SHORADEZ
restrictions: Attack only while the Cobalt kill box is open.

coordination_instructions: Request climb at Marshal; do not climb into the stack without clearance.
south-transit.description: Special Corridor (SC) for the inbound route from Juniper to Marshal, below Mesa holding.
south-transit.name: South transit corridor
south-transit.notes: Maximum 300 knots indicated; outside the period the published Jordanian routes apply.
south-transit.purpose: Keep inbound traffic below the holding stack.
restrictions: Inbound only; outbound traffic uses Marshal to Cedar.

sp-sage.description: Start point of the air assault serials.
sp-sage.name: SP Sage

coordination_instructions: Report HIGHWAY to Salti Tower; continue on the north route from Salti Dam.
vfr-salti-east.description: Published VFR arrival from the highway east of Muwaffaq Salti; it arcs north at 8 nm to Salti Dam.
vfr-salti-east.name: Salti east VFR arrival
vfr-salti-east.notes: Not sterile of other traffic; helicopters use the same highway.
vfr-salti-east.purpose: Keep VFR arrivals clear of the runway 31 final approach.
restrictions: Remain at or below 4,500 feet MSL until Salti Dam.

vrp-salti-dam.description: Visual reporting point at the dam north-east of Muwaffaq Salti; the re-entry point of the overhead pattern.
vrp-salti-dam.name: Salti Dam

zinc-mez.description: Missile engagement zone of the hostile SA-3 site that defends the Zinc depot.
zinc-mez.name: Zinc LOMEZ

zinc-pump-nfa.description: No-fire area around the civilian water pumping station beside the Zinc depot.
zinc-pump-nfa.name: Zinc pumping station NFA
restrictions: No fires or effects into the area unless Kingpin approves each mission.

PointLocation.position_description: Desert road bend south-west of the Cobalt compound.
